$doc: Vyomi capability registry — Azure DNS zones. See aws/s3.json for the contract.

azure.dns.zone.crud.title: DNS zones (create, get, list, delete) over ARM

azure.dns.zone.private.title: Private DNS zones (zoneType = Private, no public name servers)
limitations: Vyomi models public and private zones as the SAME ARM resource (Microsoft.Network/dnszones) distinguished by properties.zoneType, matching this core's shape — real Azure exposes private zones as a separate resource type (Microsoft.Network/privateDnsZones) with its own API. A zone's type is fixed at creation.

azure.dns.recordset.crud.title: Record sets (A, AAAA, CAA, CNAME, MX, NS, PTR, SOA, SRV, TXT) — create, get, list, update, delete
limitations: DS, NAPTR and TLSA record sets round-trip over the native API/CLI (az network dns record-set ds|naptr|tlsa) but, matching the real portal, have no Record set type option in this console's Add/Edit dialog.

A, AAAA and CNAME record sets can alias another Azure resource (targetResource); Vyomi stores the alias target exactly as configured but does not resolve it to the target's current records the way real Azure DNS does.

azure.dns.vnet_links.title: Virtual network links (registrationVirtualNetworks / resolutionVirtualNetworks)
limitations: Vyomi stores each zone's registration and resolution virtual networks as the two plain ARM-ref lists this core models (same shape as the real zone resource's own properties), not as separate Microsoft.Network/privateDnsZones/virtualNetworkLinks child resources — so a link has no independent name, provisioning state or autoRegistration flag of its own, and DNS resolution/auto-registration from a linked virtual network's VMs is not modelled.

azure.dns.locks.title: Resource locks (Microsoft.Authorization/locks), scoped to this DNS zone
limitations: Locks are only simulated at the resource scope (this zone); subscription- and resource-group-scoped lock lists are an honest 'Not simulated' gap, same as the real Subscription/Resource group scope-switch buttons.

azure.dns.activity_log.title: Activity log
limitations: Only console/SDK-triggered mutations made since the simulation booted are recorded (no historical backfill); severity/category filtering and the 7/30/90-day timespan picker are not modelled, and `caller` is a fixed placeholder identity rather than the real signed-in principal.

azure.dns.iam.title: Access control (IAM)
limitations: Check access, Role assignments and Deny assignments are REAL and scoped to this DNS zone's resource id: Check access runs core/azure_iam_core.py's evaluator (explicit-deny-wins, scope inheritance from the subscription/resource group), the lists filter the shared RBAC store to assignments whose scope covers it, and new assignments are created scoped to it. Principal IDs are free text (Vyomi has no real directory); 'My access' and Classic administrators stay honest gaps.

azure.dns.export_template.title: Export template
limitations: ARM/Bicep/Terraform template export for a DNS zone is not built.

azure.dns.diagnose.title: Diagnose and solve problems
limitations: The guided DNS diagnostic tiles are not modelled.
